disposition: Predeclared fallback for the final Forward+ postcard_pavilion field workload. The original final job is still running; no failure of that job is claimed.

reason.outcome: Three natural field invocations and the fourth baseline import completed; the last field PNG/report and complete results.json are absent. The earlier 9d job completed on another VM. This establishes a variable host-dependent deadline risk, not a shader regression or a failure of the final primary job.

scope.trigger: Own workflow path on the audit branch or manual dispatch. Neither the regular campaign nor the pilot recovery watches this path.
scope.workflow_comparison: Parsed both recovery YAML documents and compared all seven steps. Only the concrete WORKLOAD differs. The pinned checkout, imports, engine, resource sampler, environment, 60 warmups, 31 raw samples, first-interval exclusion and natural four-process exit requirement remain identical. Permissions are contents:read.

selection.rule: Use a qualified original final 1e91 Forward+ postcard_pavilion four-launch result whenever present. Use the recovery only when the original is explicitly failed, canceled, incomplete, or fails the pre-existing qualification checks. An in-progress original is pending. If both qualify, retain both attempts but select the original. A selected recovery must use all four of its own A/B/B/A launches from one VM. Cross-job pooling and selection by speed are excluded.
selection.retention: Commit raw numeric evidence for the selected attempt in the main 12-case replay, and preserve available numeric/log records for the nonselected attempt in a separate companion package with source/run/job/archive identities. Preserve missing final files as missing.
selection.hardware_scope: This experiment characterizes the software Vulkan runner, not a physical target GPU.
